← Toolkit

Bracket / Tournament Generator

Lets you keep more than one tournament going at once (e.g. two class periods running their own bracket).

One per line, or separated by commas. Byes are added automatically if the count isn't a power of 2.

Double elimination adds a losers bracket — a team isn't out until it loses twice. Round robin plays everybody against everybody, no eliminations.

Random shuffles the list. As entered keeps your list order (also used for byes). Ranked treats your list as seed 1..N in order and places seeds so the top two can't meet before the final — seed 1 plays the lowest seed in round 1. Round robin only affects the standings table's Seed column.

Scan to open this bracket

Scanning opens a copy of this bracket on the other device — it won't stay in sync after that.

Match schedule

Assigns each match a station and start time, round by round, so a whole tournament day can run without you refereeing traffic. Not available for double elimination yet.

Runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded. Click a name to advance it to the next round.
